hypothesis: The existing compensated E33 BF16-QK kernel can execute original MiniMax-H3 S9300 H56 D128 dense attention without materializing a score matrix, pass the paired numerical gates, and beat the exact wave32 baseline; downstream integration will separately compare it with H3's rocBLAS matrix path.

acceptance.stopping_rule: Do not integrate or tune device code unless the production dense operator passes correctness, guard-canary, determinism and ISA gates. H3 rocBLAS same-QKV, DiT oracle and full-media gates remain downstream requirements.
